correctness.rationale: On the encoded caterpillar, all leaf-support spine vertices may be simultaneously selected in a minimum closed-neighborhood dominating set; k consecutive unsupported internal spine vertices between forced supports cost floor(k/3). Verified directly by constructing permutation inversion trees and minimizing closed-neighborhood coverage for all fair-bit words with 3<=n<=9. Geometric run cycles have E(M,R,C)=(4,8/7,2), centered covariance E(U^2)=72/343, E(UV)=12/49, E(V^2)=1. Independent exact rational arithmetic yields slopes (18/343,3/49,1/4), determinant 45/4802. Regenerative CLT with exponential tails and bounded boundary moments justifies the joint distribution and covariance limits; finite checks alone do not.
